members.name: b77_A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which one of these intents best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick the single most specific matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Wants to activate a card they have received, or cannot activate it (activation steps, activation failing).
criteria.age_limit: Minimum/maximum age to open or use an account; whether children or teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay with the card or to top up; whether they are supported or not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, how to use the card at an ATM in general (not a declined withdrawal, swallowed card, fee or wrong amount).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic/auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off, how it works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer into the customer's own account (money transferred to them, or from their UK or other bank account, or they say their balance did not change) is not showing / the balance has not updated yet, including 'how long does a transfer from my UK account take, I just made one and it isn't showing'. Requires the customer to mention a transfer.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited money (a cheque, cash, or a deposit/money put into the account without saying it was a transfer) but the balance has not updated; when a deposit will show up; still waiting for money they put in.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or a transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed / beneficiary rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account, changed their mind).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring/expired card, whether it costs anything, whether the replacement can be shipped to the foreign country they are in (e.g. 'Am I able to get this shipped to China?').
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted in general: whether they can use the card at a particular kind of shop/merchant/place (asked in advance, not a specific payment that was refused - that is declined_card_payment).
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered physical card has not arrived in the post yet; tracking the card delivery; card still not received after waiting (not virtual cards).
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when the card will arrive (asked in advance), express or by-a-date delivery, delivery to certain countries.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account: adding a new or found card to the app, linking an existing card, re-linking a card they found after losing it.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card is not working or can't be used (anywhere, or e.g. 'my card wasn't working in a shop') in general (not specifically declined payments with a reason, contactless, ATM withdrawals, or the virtual card); card broken or damaged.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fees on card payments/purchases: was charged a fee when paying with the card, or asks where to check the fees for payments because they feel overcharged.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase on the statement or in the app that they don't recognise or say they didn't make.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The wrong or bad exchange rate was applied to a card payment/purchase made abroad or in a foreign currency.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, swallowed or retained the card; card stuck in the machine.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Was charged a fee for withdrawing cash from an ATM; ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal on the account that they did not make or don't recognise.
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change or reset their card PIN; where/how to change the PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised: suspect someone else is using the card or has their card details, fraud on card, card details leaked; wants to secure the card (but card itself not lost or stolen).
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments with the card are not working.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/account/card is available in; whether they can open an account or use the service if they live in or move to a certain country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was explicitly declined, rejected or refused, e.g. 'my card was not accepted in a shop'; not merely still pending, and not a general 'my card isn't working' (card_not_working).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined/rejected, the ATM refused to give cash, or they could not get the ATM to work / get money out.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected; told a transfer is not possible.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit payment on the account they don't recognise or didn't set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many times they can be used, how many can be created, transaction limits.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email or other account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; extra charges when exchanging money; why they were charged for an exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rate is in general, how exchange rates are determined, where to see current rates (not about rates on ATM withdrawals or a complaint about a wrong rate applied).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app; whether they can exchange money to a certain currency.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexpected extra charge or small fee (e.g. an extra £1/$1) on their statement that they don't understand, even if it shows as pending (e.g. 'why has my account been charged a dollar that is showing as pending?'); generic 'why was I charged extra'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through; money from a failed transfer.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held, used or exchanged; whether a specific currency is supported for holding money or exchanging.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable/single-use virtual card, what disposable cards are.
criteria.get_physical_card: Finding or receiving the PIN for their (new) card: where to find the card PIN, whether the card comes with a PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, a second card for the same account or for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting a virtual card: how to get or order one, whether virtual cards are available, cost, or not having received/seen the virtual card they requested.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; how to report or block a lost or stolen card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen, or left behind; how to access the account or secure it without their phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wanting, requesting or ordering a physical (plastic) card; how to get a physical card; cost of ordering a card; where cards can be delivered.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or password; how to reset the passcode or log in without it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase (the customer says payment or purchase) is pending or has not gone through yet, with no sign it was refused; why their payment is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or has not completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is shown as pending or still in progress and they are waiting for it to clear (without saying it was sent to someone else or into their own account); how long it will stay pending; waiting forever for a transfer (e.g. 'I've been waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?').
criteria.pin_blocked: Card PIN is blocked, often after entering the wrong PIN too many times; how to unblock it.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or a salary into the account; getting paid, receiving payments from others.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Expecting a refund from a merchant that has not appeared in the account yet; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase; how refunds work; what to do to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled and the money came back, or a card payment keeps getting reversed.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, credit cards) can be used to top up and which currencies are supported for cards/top-ups.
criteria.terminate_account: Wants to close, delete or cancel their account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer: only when the customer explicitly says the top-up/adding money is done by (bank) transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up or adding money to the account, including when the top-up method is not stated (e.g. 'do you charge for adding money?'); being charged for a card top-up.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up or deposit using cash or a cheque; whether cash/cheque top-ups are possible (not fees after withdrawing cash).
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, or did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum top-up amount, how much or how often they can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or reversed; topped-up money appeared and then disappeared from the balance.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; topping up with a debit or credit card; money disappeared when topping up by card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Was charged twice / a duplicate charge for the same transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Was charged a fee for a transfer; why a transfer cost a fee; also higher or new fees for using the account / doing banking abroad (e.g. 'why was I charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad?', 'has there been an increase in fees since I used my account overseas?'), when no card purchase, ATM withdrawal or currency exchange is named.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into their own account from another bank/account (incl. how bank transfers in work, being unable to transfer money into their account); adding money by bank transfer; transfer details for incoming money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer or transaction the customer made/sent (to someone else, or with no destination stated, e.g. 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet') has not arrived / is still not there / is taking too long to complete (e.g. 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete?'); the recipient has not received the money.
criteria.transfer_timing: Only about duration: how long transfers take to arrive or be processed, including incoming transfers from a named place they are waiting for (e.g. 'I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?', 'how long does a transfer from Europe take?'); when transfers reach the account; asked in general, not about a specific transfer they already made that is not showing.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Tried to verify identity but it failed, was rejected or the verification is not working for them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity or complete the identity checks (incl. not sure how to complete them); what documents are needed; how long identity verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or proving the source of their funds/money; where to show the source of available money.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for topping up; the verification code for a top-up card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working or was declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing or wanting a Visa or a Mastercard card specifically.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed; why they must provide personal information or documents.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, less than requested, but the full amount was debited.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Any question or complaint about the exchange rate applied to cash/ATM withdrawals (abroad or in foreign ATMs), including neutral questions like 'what is the exchange rate for foreign ATMs'.

criteria.exchange_charge: Request type: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; extra charges when exchanging money; why they were charged for an exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: Request type: What the exchange rate is in general, how exchange rates are determined, where to see current rates (not about rates on ATM withdrawals or a complaint about a wrong rate applied).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Request type: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app; whether they can exchange money to a certain currency.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Request type: An unexpected extra charge or small fee (e.g. an extra £1/$1) on their statement that they don't understand, even if it shows as pending (e.g. 'why has my account been charged a dollar that is showing as pending?'); generic 'why was I charged extra'.
criteria.failed_transfer: Request type: A transfer failed or did not go through; money from a failed transfer.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Request type: Which fiat currencies can be held, used or exchanged; whether a specific currency is supported for holding money or exchanging.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Request type: How to get or create a disposable/single-use virtual card, what disposable cards are.
criteria.get_physical_card: Request type: Finding or receiving the PIN for their (new) card: where to find the card PIN, whether the card comes with a PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Request type: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, a second card for the same account or for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Request type: Getting a virtual card: how to get or order one, whether virtual cards are available, cost, or not having received/seen the virtual card they requested.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Request type: Card was lost or stolen; how to report or block a lost or stolen card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Request type: Phone was lost or stolen, or left behind; how to access the account or secure it without their phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Request type: Wanting, requesting or ordering a physical (plastic) card; how to get a physical card; cost of ordering a card; where cards can be delivered.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Request type: Forgot the app passcode or password; how to reset the passcode or log in without it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: Request type: A card payment/purchase (the customer says payment or purchase) is pending or has not gone through yet, with no sign it was refused; why their payment is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Request type: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: Request type: A top-up is pending or has not completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: Request type: A transfer is shown as pending or still in progress and they are waiting for it to clear (without saying it was sent to someone else or into their own account); how long it will stay pending; waiting forever for a transfer (e.g. 'I've been waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?').
criteria.pin_blocked: Request type: Card PIN is blocked, often after entering the wrong PIN too many times; how to unblock it.
criteria.receiving_money: Request type: How to receive money or a salary into the account; getting paid, receiving payments from others.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Request type: Expecting a refund from a merchant that has not appeared in the account yet; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Request type: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase; how refunds work; what to do to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Request type: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled and the money came back, or a card payment keeps getting reversed.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Request type: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, credit cards) can be used to top up and which currencies are supported for cards/top-ups.
criteria.terminate_account: Request type: Wants to close, delete or cancel their account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Request type: Fees for topping up by bank transfer: only when the customer explicitly says the top-up/adding money is done by (bank) transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Request type: Fees for topping up or adding money to the account, including when the top-up method is not stated (e.g. 'do you charge for adding money?'); being charged for a card top-up.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Request type: How to top up or deposit using cash or a cheque; whether cash/cheque top-ups are possible (not fees after withdrawing cash).
criteria.top_up_failed: Request type: A top-up failed, was declined, or did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Request type: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum top-up amount, how much or how often they can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: Request type: A top-up was reverted or reversed; topped-up money appeared and then disappeared from the balance.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Request type: How to top up using a card; topping up with a debit or credit card; money disappeared when topping up by card.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Request type: Was charged twice / a duplicate charge for the same transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Request type: Was charged a fee for a transfer; why a transfer cost a fee; also higher or new fees for using the account / doing banking abroad (e.g. 'why was I charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad?', 'has there been an increase in fees since I used my account overseas?'), when no card purchase, ATM withdrawal or currency exchange is named.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Request type: How to transfer money into their own account from another bank/account (incl. how bank transfers in work, being unable to transfer money into their account); adding money by bank transfer; transfer details for incoming money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Request type: A transfer or transaction the customer made/sent (to someone else, or with no destination stated, e.g. 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet') has not arrived / is still not there / is taking too long to complete (e.g. 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete?'); the recipient has not received the money.
criteria.transfer_timing: Request type: Only about duration: how long transfers take to arrive or be processed, including incoming transfers from a named place they are waiting for (e.g. 'I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?', 'how long does a transfer from Europe take?'); when transfers reach the account; asked in general, not about a specific transfer they already made that is not showing.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Request type: Tried to verify identity but it failed, was rejected or the verification is not working for them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Request type: How to verify identity or complete the identity checks (incl. not sure how to complete them); what documents are needed; how long identity verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Request type: Verifying or proving the source of their funds/money; where to show the source of available money.
criteria.verify_top_up: Request type: Verifying a top-up or the card used for topping up; the verification code for a top-up card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Request type: The virtual card is not working or was declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Request type: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing or wanting a Visa or a Mastercard card specifically.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Request type: Why identity verification is needed; why they must provide personal information or documents.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Request type: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, less than requested, but the full amount was debited.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Request type: Any question or complaint about the exchange rate applied to cash/ATM withdrawals (abroad or in foreign ATMs), including neutral questions like 'what is the exchange rate for foreign ATMs'.
